title: Travel
about: Collocations for talking about travel: when to say travel, journey or trip (business travel, a day trip, a tiring journey), flying (board the plane, a connecting flight, an aisle seat) and places to stay (a family-run hotel, budget accommodation, fully booked).

parts.title: Travel, journey, trip
parts.note: Українською все це — «подорож» чи «поїздка», а англійською слова працюють по-різному. Travel — переважно дієслово (to travel) або незлічуваний іменник про подорожі загалом: business travel, air travel; «a travel» не кажуть. Часто travel стоїть перед іншим іменником: travel agent, travel arrangements, travel brochures. Journey — дорога з одного місця в інше, особливо довга: a tiring journey, the return journey. Trip — поїздка кудись і назад, часто коротка й з певною метою: a business trip, a day trip, a boat trip.

items.pattern: make (your) travel arrangements · usually plural
items.meaning: the plans and bookings you make for a journey: tickets, a place to stay, getting to and from the airport
items.example: My sister loves planning, so she always makes the **travel arrangements** for our family holidays.
more: Have you sorted out your **travel arrangements** for the wedding in Cork yet?
The school makes all the **travel arrangements** for the exchange trip, so parents only need to pay.
items.watchOut: Travel тут стоїть перед іменником як означення, тому без -s: travel arrangements, не travels arrangements. Arrangements майже завжди в множині. «Я сам усе організував для поїздки» — I made the travel arrangements myself; organisation of the travel звучить неприродно.

items.pattern: a travel agent · a travel agency · go to the travel agent's (British)
items.meaning: a person or company whose job is to arrange holidays, tickets and hotels for people
items.example: We booked our honeymoon through a **travel agent**, and she found us a room with a sea view.
more: My parents still go to the **travel agent's** on the high street to book their holidays.
The **travel agent** rang to say our flight times had changed.
items.watchOut: «Турагенція» — a travel agency або британське the travel agent's; tourist agency — калька. Людина, яка там працює, — a travel agent.

items.pattern: business travel · uncountable · also air travel, foreign travel
items.meaning: travelling for work, as a general activity
items.example: **Business travel** sounds glamorous, but it's mostly airports and hotel rooms.
more: The company pays for **business travel**, but not for your family if they come along.
My dad's job involved a lot of **business travel**, so he missed most of my football matches.
items.watchOut: Business travel — відрядження загалом, незлічуване: a lot of business travel, не a business travel і не business travels. Одне конкретне відрядження — a business trip.

items.pattern: a business trip · be (away) on / go on a business trip
items.meaning: one particular journey somewhere for work
items.example: Mum's away on a **business trip** to Warsaw, so Dad's doing the school run this week.
more: I've been on three **business trips** this month and seen nothing but meeting rooms.
If your **business trip** ends on a Friday, why not stay for the weekend?
items.watchOut: «У відрядженні» — on a business trip, не in a business trip і не on a business travel. «Поїхати у відрядження» — go on a business trip. Калька з російського «командировка» (command, mission) тут не працює.

items.pattern: a day trip (to sth) · go on / take a day trip
items.meaning: a visit to a place when you go there and come back on the same day
items.uk: одноденна поїздка, поїздка на один день
items.example: We went on a **day trip** to Cambridge and had a picnic by the river.
more: The hotel runs **day trips** to the lakes every Tuesday.
Paris is too far for a **day trip** from here, so let's stay a night.
items.watchOut: «Поїздка на один день» — a day trip; кажуть go on a day trip або take a day trip. A daily trip — щоденна поїздка (наприклад, на роботу), а не одноденна.

items.pattern: a boat trip (to / round / along sth) · take / go on a boat trip
items.meaning: a short journey on a boat for pleasure, often to see a place from the water
items.example: We took a **boat trip** round the harbour and saw dolphins jumping next to us.
more: The **boat trip** to the caves was the best part of our holiday.
Grandma gets seasick, so she stayed on the beach while we went on a **boat trip**.
items.watchOut: «Морська прогулянка», «прогулянка на катері» — a boat trip, не a sea walk і не a boat walk: walk — лише пішки. Зазвичай кажуть take a boat trip або go on a boat trip.

items.pattern: Safe journey! · Have a safe journey (home)!
items.meaning: what you say to someone who is about to travel, to wish them a good journey
items.example: Thanks for coming to the party, and **safe journey** home!
more: Mum always texts '**Safe journey**!' when I leave for the airport.
We'll miss you. **Have a safe journey**, and come back soon.
items.watchOut: «Щасливої дороги!» — Safe journey! або Have a safe journey!, ще Safe travels! Не Happy road! і не Good way! А have a safe travel — помилка: тут travel не вживається з a.

items.pattern: a tiring / long / exhausting journey
items.meaning: a journey that makes you feel very tired
items.example: It was a **tiring journey**: two trains, a bus and a long walk with heavy bags.
more: Driving through the night with two kids in the back is a **tiring journey** for anyone.
It's a **tiring journey**, so book a hotel near the airport for the first night.
items.watchOut: Tiring — той, що втомлює: a tiring journey. Tired — втомлений, про людину: I was tired after the journey. Не a tired journey. І «важка дорога» — не a heavy journey, а a tiring, hard або difficult journey.

items.pattern: the return journey (home) · on the return journey ↔ the outward journey
items.meaning: the journey back to the place where you started
items.example: On the **return journey** the train was so full that we had to stand all the way.
more: We'd spent all our money, so the **return journey** was just sandwiches and tap water.
Book the **return journey** now; the trains get busy on Sunday evenings.
items.watchOut: «На зворотному шляху» — on the return journey або on the way back, не on the back journey. Британське a return ticket — квиток туди й назад, а не «повернений» квиток.

items.pattern: the outward journey / flight ↔ the return journey
items.meaning: the journey to a place, as opposed to the journey back
items.example: The **outward journey** took ten hours, but the way home felt much shorter.
more: On the **outward journey** the plane was half empty, but coming back it was full.
Your ticket covers the **outward journey** on Monday and the return on Friday.
items.watchOut: «Дорога туди» — the outward journey або the way there; there journey не кажуть.

items.pattern: a travel brochure · pick up / look through travel brochures
items.meaning: small magazines with photos and information about holidays, hotels and places to visit
items.example: I picked up a few **travel brochures** at the airport, and now I really want to visit Norway.
more: My grandad keeps old **travel brochures** from the 1970s; the prices are hilarious.
The **travel brochure** promised a quiet beach, but there was a nightclub next door.
items.watchOut: Brochure британською — /ˈbrəʊʃə/, з наголосом на перший склад. Рекламний буклет — a brochure, а не a prospect: prospect — перспектива, шанс.

items.pattern: a camping trip · go on a camping trip · go camping
items.meaning: a trip when you sleep in a tent for one or more nights
items.uk: поїздка з наметами, похід із наметом
items.example: On our first **camping trip**, it rained all night and the tent leaked.
more: Take a warm sleeping bag on your **camping trip**: nights in the mountains are cold.
The scouts are going on a **camping trip** to Wales next weekend.
items.watchOut: «Поїхати в похід із наметами» — go camping (без to) або go on a camping trip. Місце для наметів, «кемпінг», — a campsite (британське), а не a camping.

items.pattern: an overnight journey / train / bus / flight
items.meaning: a journey that goes on through the night
items.example: It's an **overnight journey** by train, so we've booked beds in a sleeper.
more: The **overnight journey** to the mountains is cheap, but you won't get much sleep.
We saved money on a hotel by making the **overnight journey** by coach.
items.watchOut: Overnight — «через ніч, нічний»: an overnight journey, an overnight train. Не плутай з nightly — «щонічний, що буває кожної ночі». Ще overnight означає «раптово, за одну ніч»: become famous overnight.

items.pattern: in-flight entertainment · uncountable · formal
items.meaning: films, music and games that passengers can watch or play during a flight
items.uk: розваги на борту (фільми, музика, ігри під час польоту)
items.example: The kids were quiet for eight hours thanks to the **in-flight entertainment**.
more: The **in-flight entertainment** wasn't working, so I read my book the whole way.
Cheap airlines usually don't offer any **in-flight entertainment**, so bring your own films.
items.watchOut: In-flight — «під час польоту», пишеться через дефіс. Entertainment незлічуване: the in-flight entertainment is good, не entertainments.

items.pattern: the in-flight magazine · in the seat pocket
items.meaning: the free magazine an airline gives passengers to read during a flight
items.uk: бортовий журнал (який лежить у кишені крісла)
items.example: I found a great restaurant in Lisbon thanks to an article in the **in-flight magazine**.
more: The **in-flight magazine** had a long article about hiking in Iceland.
You can take the **in-flight magazine** home with you; it's free.
items.watchOut: Журнал, який читають, — a magazine. Journal — щоденник або науковий журнал, тому on-board journal — калька.

items.pattern: fasten your seatbelt(s) · keep your seatbelt fastened · formal
items.meaning: close the belt on your seat so that it holds you safely
items.example: As soon as I sat down, the flight attendant asked me to **fasten my seatbelt**.
more: Please **fasten your seatbelts**; we're expecting some turbulence.
My little boy can **fasten his seatbelt** in the car all by himself now.
items.watchOut: «Пристебніться» — fasten your seatbelt; у розмові ще put on або do up your seatbelt. Не close і не tie your belt. Fasten читається /ˈfɑːsn/: t не вимовляється.

items.pattern: board the plane / a flight / a train (no preposition) · boarding · a boarding pass · formal
items.meaning: get on a plane, ship, train or bus
items.uk: сісти в літак, піднятися на борт
items.example: We **boarded the plane** in the rain, climbing the steps with our hoods up.
more: Families with small children may **board the plane** first.
Have your passport and boarding pass ready before you **board**.
items.watchOut: Board — без прийменника: board the plane, не board on the plane і не board in the plane. У розмові частіше get on the plane. «Посадка» — boarding: Boarding starts at 9.15.

items.pattern: a connecting flight · catch / miss your connecting flight · a connection
items.meaning: a second flight that continues your journey after you change planes
items.uk: наступний рейс після пересадки, стикувальний (трансферний) рейс
items.example: There's no direct flight to Porto, so we've got a **connecting flight** in Madrid.
more: If you miss your **connecting flight**, the airline should put you on the next one.
We had three hours to wait for our **connecting flight**, so we had lunch at the airport.
items.watchOut: «Стикувальний рейс» — a connecting flight (з -ing), не a connected flight. «Спізнитися на рейс» — miss a flight, не lose і не pass a flight.

items.pattern: a domestic flight ↔ an international flight · domestic departures
items.meaning: a flight between two places in the same country
items.example: **Domestic flights** in Norway are quick, but they're not cheap.
more: For **domestic flights**, you only need to be at the airport an hour before.
The **domestic** terminal is a five-minute walk from the international one.
items.watchOut: Domestic тут не «домашній», а «внутрішній, у межах країни». Можна сказати й internal flight; inner flight чи home flight — неприродно.

items.pattern: a window seat ↔ an aisle seat · ask for / book a window seat
items.meaning: a seat next to the window on a plane, train or bus
items.example: I booked a **window seat** so I could take photos of the Alps.
more: The kids always fight over the **window seat** on the train.
From my **window seat** I could see our house as we took off.
items.watchOut: «Місце біля вікна» — a window seat, не a place near the window: місце в транспорті — seat, а не place.

items.pattern: an aisle seat ↔ a window seat
items.meaning: a seat next to the narrow passage between the rows of seats
items.example: I always choose an **aisle seat** on the train, so I can get off quickly at my stop.
more: There were no **aisle seats** left, so I was squeezed into the middle.
The trolley keeps bumping your elbow if you're in an **aisle seat**.
items.watchOut: Aisle читається /aɪl/, як I'll: s не вимовляється. Прохід між рядами — aisle, а не passage чи corridor. Не плутай з alley (провулок) та isle (острів).

items.pattern: a charter flight ↔ a scheduled flight · a chartered plane
items.meaning: a flight on a plane that a company, often a holiday company, hires for its own customers
items.example: Our package holiday to Crete included a **charter flight** from Manchester.
more: **Charter flights** often leave at strange times, like four in the morning.
The football club took a **charter flight** to the away match.

items.pattern: a scheduled flight ↔ a charter flight
items.meaning: a regular flight that an airline runs at fixed times from its timetable
items.example: **Scheduled flights** cost more, but you can choose almost any day and time.
more: There are three **scheduled flights** a day from Bristol to Dublin.
The airline cuts its **scheduled flights** to Bergen to two a week in winter.
items.watchOut: Британська вимова schedule — /ˈʃedjuːl/, американська — /ˈskedʒuːl/. «Рейс за розкладом» — a scheduled flight.

items.pattern: a smooth flight ↔ a bumpy flight · have a smooth flight
items.meaning: a flight where the plane moves steadily and doesn't shake
items.example: We had a **smooth flight** to Malta and landed ten minutes early.
more: Despite the strong wind on the ground, it was a surprisingly **smooth flight**.
Nervous flyers relax a little once they realise it's going to be a **smooth flight**.
items.watchOut: «М'який, спокійний політ» — a smooth flight, не a soft flight. Smooth — рівний, без поштовхів.

items.pattern: a bumpy flight ↔ a smooth flight · a bumpy landing / ride
items.meaning: a flight where the plane shakes a lot, usually because of wind or storms
items.example: It was a **bumpy flight**, and my little girl held my hand the whole way.
more: The pilot warned us it might be a **bumpy flight** because of the storms over France.
After such a **bumpy flight**, I was glad to be back on the ground.
items.watchOut: «Літак трясло» — it was a bumpy flight, не a shaking flight. Саме явище — turbulence.

items.pattern: a family-run hotel / business / restaurant
items.meaning: a hotel that one family owns and manages, with family members working in it
items.example: We stayed in a little **family-run hotel**; the owner's mum made the best breakfast I've ever had.
more: Most of the hotels on the island are small and **family-run**.
I prefer **family-run hotels** to big chains; they feel more personal.
items.watchOut: Family-run — готель ведуть члени однієї родини. Це не означає, що він саме для сімей з дітьми: такий готель — family-friendly.

items.pattern: a run-down hotel / area / building · rather / a bit run-down
items.meaning: in bad condition because nobody has spent money on it or looked after it
items.example: The hotel was cheap but rather **run-down**: the carpets were stained and the windows didn't shut properly.
more: They bought a **run-down** cottage and spent three years fixing it up.
The station is in a **run-down** part of town, so take a taxi at night.
items.watchOut: Run-down про будівлю чи район — занедбаний; про людину — виснажений, змучений: I've been feeling run-down lately. Не плутай з broken down — зламався (про машину).

items.pattern: a luxury hotel / flat / car · luxury goods
items.meaning: a very comfortable and expensive hotel with the best of everything
items.example: For their silver wedding, my parents spent a weekend in a **luxury hotel** in the mountains.
more: The **luxury hotel** had a pool on the roof and a spa in the basement.
We couldn't afford to stay at the **luxury hotel**, but we did have a coffee in its bar.
items.watchOut: «Готель класу люкс» — a luxury hotel, не a lux hotel. Можна й a luxurious hotel, але найчастіше кажуть luxury hotel. Вимова: /ˈlʌkʃəri/.

items.pattern: a smart hotel / restaurant / area · smart = elegant (British)
items.meaning: an elegant, fashionable and usually expensive hotel
items.example: We usually stay in hostels, but for my birthday we booked a **smart hotel** by the river.
more: The **smart hotels** are all near the harbour, and the cheap ones are up the hill.
You can't go into that **smart hotel** bar in trainers.
items.watchOut: Smart тут не «розумний», а «елегантний, шикарний»: a smart hotel, a smart suit, a smart area. Це переважно британське значення.

items.pattern: budget accommodation / hotels / airlines · accommodation is uncountable
items.meaning: very cheap places to stay, such as hostels or simple guesthouses
items.example: We found **budget accommodation** in a student hostel for twenty euros a night.
more: If you're travelling on very little money, look for **budget accommodation** outside the city centre.
The tourist office has a list of **budget accommodation** in the area.
items.watchOut: Accommodation у британській англійській зазвичай незлічуване: budget accommodation, а не an accommodation чи accommodations (так частіше кажуть американці). Пишеться з двома c і двома m. Житло для туристів — accommodation, а не living.

items.pattern: make a reservation (for sb / for + time) · have a reservation · = book
items.meaning: arrange for a hotel room, a table or a seat to be kept for you
items.example: I'll ring the restaurant and **make a reservation** for seven o'clock.
more: Did you **make a reservation**, or shall we just turn up and hope for a table?
You need to **make a reservation** at least a month ahead in summer.
items.watchOut: «Забронювати» — make a reservation або просто book; не do a reservation. «У мене бронь» — I have a reservation (або a booking). Reserve — дієслово (reserve a table), reservation — іменник.

items.pattern: be / get fully booked · fully booked up
items.meaning: with no rooms, seats or tables left, because people have booked them all
items.example: We left it too late; every hotel in town was **fully booked** for the festival.
more: Swimming lessons for kids get **fully booked** within an hour.
I tried to change my flight, but the earlier one was **fully booked**.
items.watchOut: «Немає вільних місць» — fully booked, не full booked і не fully busy. Про готель можна сказати й The hotel is full.

warmup.explain: Відрядження — business trips (злічуване). Business travel — незлічуване, тому travels тут не підходить. Business journeys так не кажуть.

warmup.uk: — Щасливої дороги! — гукнула мама, коли ми рушили.
warmup.q: '___!' Mum called as we drove off.
warmup.explain: Щасливої дороги — Safe journey! або Have a safe journey!

warmup.uk: Дорога до бабусі дуже виснажлива, тому ми їздимо до неї лише влітку.
warmup.q: The journey to Grandma's is very ___, so we only visit her in the summer.
warmup.explain: Tiring — той, що втомлює (дорога); tired — втомлений (людина).
Пристебнути пасок — fasten your seatbelt (у розмові ще put on / do up).

warmup.q: Can I have an ___ seat, please?
warmup.explain: Прохід між рядами — aisle /aɪl/. Alley — провулок, isle — острів.

warmup.uk: На весілля сестри ми зупинилися в шикарному готелі.
warmup.q: For my sister's wedding, we stayed in a ___ hotel.
warmup.explain: Smart у британській англійській — ще й «елегантний, шикарний»: a smart hotel.

warmup.q: Have you ___ a reservation at the hotel?
warmup.explain: Забронювати — make a reservation (або book), не do.

warmup.uk: У вихідні в ресторані все заброньовано.
warmup.q: The restaurant is ___ booked at the weekend.
warmup.explain: Усе заброньовано — fully booked: прислівник fully, а не прикметник full.

A.q: Sorry I missed your call; I was on a business ___ in Belfast.
A.explain: Одне відрядження — a business trip. Business travel — відрядження загалом, без a.

A.q: My parents never book online; they always go to a ___ agent.
A.explain: Турагент — a travel agent; tourist agent — калька.

A.q: We drove there in five hours, but the ___ journey took eight because of the traffic.
A.explain: Дорога назад — the return journey; дорога туди — the outward journey. Back journey не кажуть.

B.q: Our flight was called, so we finished our coffee and ___ the plane.
B.explain: Сісти в літак — board the plane, без прийменника.

B.q: A flight from Glasgow to London is a ___ flight because it doesn't leave the country.
B.explain: Внутрішній рейс — a domestic flight. Domestic тут — «у межах країни», а не «домашній».

B.q: Charter flights are usually cheaper than ___ flights, which run all year to a timetable.
B.explain: Рейс за розкладом — a scheduled flight; протилежність — a charter flight.

C.q: The beds were old and the paint was peeling. It was a rather ___ hotel.
We're students, so we always look for ___ accommodation: hostels or a friend's sofa.
C.explain: Дешеве житло — budget accommodation. Economic — пов'язаний з економікою, а не «дешевий».

C.q: We didn't ___ a reservation, so we had to wait an hour for a table.
C.explain: Забронювати — make a reservation. Take a reservation каже ресторан, коли приймає бронь.

example.title: A holiday that almost went wrong
example.uk:
Минулого травня я сам зайнявся організацією поїздки, замість того щоб іти до турагента. Я знайшов дешевий чартерний рейс на Крит і маленький сімейний готель біля пляжу.

Дорога туди була катастрофою. Літак увесь час трясло, і мого сина знудило просто на бортовий журнал. Коли ми нарешті приїхали, у готелі не лишилося жодного вільного номера, хоча я забронював кімнату ще в березні. На щастя, у двоюрідного брата власника знайшлася вільна кімната.

Решта тижня була чудовою. Ми вирушили на прогулянку катером до крихітного острова і щодня купалися. А зворотна дорога? Спокійний політ без трясіння і жодних сюрпризів.
example.en:
Last May I made all the [[travel arrangements|a1]] myself instead of going to a [[travel agent|a2]]. I found a cheap [[charter flight|b9]] to Crete and a small [[family-run hotel|c1]] near the beach.

The [[outward journey|a10]] was a disaster. It was a [[bumpy flight|b12]], and my son was sick all over the [[in-flight magazine|b2]]. When we finally arrived, the hotel was [[fully booked|c7]], even though I had [[made a reservation|c6]] in March. Luckily, the owner's cousin had a free room.

The rest of the week was perfect. We took a [[boat trip|a6]] to a tiny island and swam every day. And the [[return journey|a9]]? A [[smooth flight|b11]] and no surprises at all.
